content_text: Mr Deakins, what are your thoughts between the skypanel x and the Vortex 8? they are very similar. except that the hyperoptic on the skypanel X add a great beam of light that the V8 doesn’t have… just in a general sense, if you were building out a lighting kit, which would you choose? Thanks in advance for your knowledge!
